settled.lesson: 40 recommendations: 0 target, 3 stop, 37 squared off; +58.4R in total. Best: BANKNIFTY PE  at 12:54 (+2.6R, ran 705 pts in favour). Worst: BANKNIFTY PE  at 09:35 (-1.0R). 13 squared-off trades reached 2R during the day and gave part of it back - the rules hold to 15:15 by design; the backtest says trailing earlier did not help. India VIX was 18.6 at the open. Carry forward: one trade per rule per day, the index-level stop decides, premium paths are shown so you can see where the plan and the option diverged.
